messages.subject: backend capacity before the v3 push
messages.body:
my take: the backend team is now the bottleneck.

- api backlog is at ~3.5 weeks and growing
- jonas is solo on the scanner integration, zero slack
- the driver-sync work keeps slipping, which is on the critical path for v3

options as i see them:
1. one senior backend hire, can own sync + integrations from month two
2. two juniors, cheaper per head but needs me or jonas to babysit for months

I lean option 1 but it's a budget call. Marta, can we get this moving this week? Recruiting lead time matters.

Cheers, Dev

messages.body:
ok good. I'll draft the technical profile with jonas and send it to ingrid before wednesday so the posting can go up end of week. must-haves: distributed queues, postgres at some scale, and someone who will actually ask about our failure modes in the interview instead of reciting buzzwords.
